info.title: BIFlow API — Auditor & BO4-12
info.description:
Tasnim's part of BIFlow, over HTTP.

* **BO4-12** — is a comparison honest? 5 checks, a justified fix, the user's decision.
* **BO3 Auditor** — SHAP explanations of anomalies, the append-only audit journal (hash chain),
  drift monitoring, and the *why?* agent (LLM + read-only tools, every number fact-checked).

Every response is a contract of `contracts/` (version in `/health`).

get.description: What each agent of the DAG wrote for this run. Data steps come from the base run.

Samar's dashboard (dashboard_spec.json + chart_advice.json + the prepared data). The data is read
from the run's own dashboard/ folder by FILE NAME only: the absolute paths of the spec are never used.

post.description:
Malek's agent (semantic.request) reads the question with the base run's glossary and KPI
catalog and proposes metric, dimensions, periods. Only a PROPOSAL for the form: nothing is
computed and its journal lines go to a temporary journal, thrown away. What counts is the
request the user submits (POST /comparisons), which is journaled.
Samar's intake: the user's CSV files and question run through the whole DAG, in the background.
The user's answer to the PII or ETL review, written in the journal; the run resumes.

get.description:
Runs whose data can answer a NEW question (POST /comparisons): coverage profile,
warehouse and catalog present. Custom runs (custom_*) reuse another run's data: left out.

Everything the result screen needs: question, BO4-12 verdict, which periods the
dashboard uses, integrity of the journal, anomalies, drift.
